scope: memory_core with EARLY_LOADS=1 (no caches) (LSQ part 3, landings 1 and 2). Loads and stores enter the IQ as port-1-only work, compute addresses on issue port 1 and fill rtl/memory/load_store_queue.sv. Cacheable, idempotent, non-faulting loads read the data port before reaching the ROB head once no older store has an unknown address, and complete on issue lane 1 (sharing its PRF write port with the ALU). A load whose bytes are all covered by older stores (queued, or the retired store still draining to memory) completes from store_forward without a memory access; a partial overlap waits for the store to drain. Early loads run alongside the head path and share the data port with it. Stores, MMIO/uncached loads and address faults keep the head path, fed from a per-ROB-slot record. Memory ops still dispatch and retire solo.
verification: Sail lockstep differential of fetched_core_tb (random backpressure, stall/hold-drain/reset modes) on this profile, cpi-check, RTL assertions in load_store_unit/load_store_queue/store_forward. The memory_core_tb scenario suite still covers only the EARLY_LOADS=0 head path.
